title: exercise-request
description: Ordinary form input: topic, speakers and approximate word length; all other controls optional. No corpus selection is required.

topic.description: The user topic retained verbatim in preparation; public topic may be shown to the listener.

speaker_count.description: Distinct speaker roles; each appears in the generated text. One means monologue; more means dialogue.

text_length_words.description: Approximate word target excluding speaker labels. Actual canonical/mutated counts are shown, not an exact-length rejection gate.

english_level.description: Optional generated-text level. Null means unconstrained, not an inferred participant level.

category_families.description: Optional broad families. Empty means automatic choice; pronunciation expands to both original pronunciation domains. Concrete leaf IDs are chosen by the mutation phase.

mutation_count.description: Optional exact number of independent true-error events. Null delegates choice; zero preserves control-only exercises.

mutation_seed.description: Optional seed for recipe selection/placement. Saved actual model output, not provider determinism, owns replay.

audio_backend.description: Optional synthesis choice; null inherits workspace speech selection.

category_ids.description: Optional exact registered error leaves. Nonempty restricts generation to these leaves and requests at least one true error per leaf unless mutation_count is zero. Empty/absent retains broad-family/advanced target selection.

severity_levels.description: Optional allowed true-error severities. Empty/absent means any; existing weights remain 1/2/3/4 independently of count or CEFR.
